title_suggestion: How a Blind Horse Broke World Records
style: Clean, smooth 3D character animation with bright, direct lighting and vibrant outdoor lighting. Smooth camera pans and close-up medical cuts.
narration: Clear, steady, and uplifting narrative tone.
never_change: The white horse and the female trainer character model.

facts.detail: A trainer places a blindfold over her horse's eyes.
The horse is initially hesitant to walk without sight.
Repeated practice builds the horse's confidence walking blind.
The horse developed painful, debilitating eye conditions.
One severely damaged eye required surgical removal.
Blindness training began before the second eye failed.
The second failing eye was eventually surgically removed.
The fully blind horse achieved outdoor riding, jumping competitions, and three world records.

points: A trainer puts a blindfold on her horse.
The horse hesitates at first due to fear.
Consistent guided practice builds its trust and walking ability.
clips.visual: Medium shot of trainer blindfolding horse, transitioning to a time-lapse clock overlay as they walk.

points: Severe disease affected both eyes of the horse.
The worst eye was surgically extracted and stitched.
clips.visual: Zoom into the horse's diseased eye, followed by a vet performing surgical closure.

points: Proactive blindfold training prepared the horse for total vision loss.
The remaining eye was ultimately removed as well.
clips.visual: Close-up of blindfold placement over the remaining eye, followed by surgical removal graphic.

points: The horse adapted successfully to total blindness.
It completed trail rides, show jumping, and secured three world records.
clips.visual: Tracking shot of horse trail riding, jumping stadium hurdles, and trainer holding award plaques.

coverage: Every individual fact listed appears sequentially in exactly one clip segment.
notes: Timings are tight due to fast graphic transitions during medical sequences.
